prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Livermorium (Lv) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a steelworks floor beside a glowing blast furnace, sparks and molten metal pouring under a high iron roof
Time of day: daytime indoors — bright, even light filling the room; daylight bouncing softly off pale walls.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a star goddess costume cut as a cropped top with a short skirt or hot pants — midnight blue, crystal stars and a crescent headpiece; styled with a few thin stacked bangles on one wrist; right now — the heat of the place has left a fine sheen on her skin, her top clinging lightly at the collar and the small of her back, a few damp strands at her temples; the fabric stays opaque, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera slightly below, looking up at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand reaches gently toward the camera.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — livermorium: a synthetic superheavy element first made in 2000 by firing calcium ions at a curium target, in a joint effort between a northern science town and a laboratory across the ocean, and named for that laboratory and its valley town; the valley has been known for its vineyards since the 1880s, and in 1889 one of its wines won a gold medal at a great world exhibition; today the laboratory houses the largest laser on Earth, a building the size of three playing fields that focuses one hundred and ninety-two beams onto a single point and, in the winter of 2022, first drew more energy from that point than it put in; it sits below oxygen, sulfur, selenium, tellurium and polonium, and its atoms last only tens of milliseconds before decaying into flerovium — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

observations: 선택한 해당 세계 원본을 참조한 성인 여성 한 명. 얼굴·머리색·피부톤을 시각 비교함.
실제 원본 크기와 계획 비율이 일치함.
눈에 띄는 추가·단절 팔다리는 없음. 손가락 미세 윤곽과 겹침은 완전한 자동 검증 대상이 아니며 시각 검수함.
일상 의상·배경 곳곳에 포도/잎 장식이 생성되어 원소 모티브를 의상에 쓰지 않는 규칙과 차이 있음. 결과 보존.
